answer: Clone riders booked night patrol slots on the north summit ridge and never left the depot, so teams lost the radio window. To keep a slot, a claimant must lift the 2.7 kg ferrous trail weight from rack R-9 at hut 4, hike the 41 m switchback to cairn C-17, and release a 12-second chirp on the falcon horn at pin 3-6 before the 04:05 bell. Weight must stay within 30 g of 2.7 kg, the hike 48-70 s, and the chirp log must match the rack seal and cairn stamp. An 80-chip bond is taken even on refuse. A late log, a reused seal, or a weight that never leaves rack R-9 voids the slot for five bells.
